landing.hero.title: Every family has a shape. {accent}
landing.hero.body: A private, collaborative family tree built as a living graph. Add people, connect parents and partners, and attach the photographs and documents that hold the stories together.
landing.hero.note: Free to use and open source. Your tree stays private to the people you invite.
landing.features.title: A tree you can actually wander.
landing.features.body: The graph is the main view, not a list. People, partners, children and media all live in one connected picture, so the shape of a family stays visible.
landing.feature.graph.title: A real graph, not a list
landing.feature.graph.body: People are nodes, parent and partner links are edges, and every branch stays visible at a glance.
landing.feature.photos.title: Photos live in the tree
landing.feature.photos.body: Portraits sit on the person. Albums, letters and documents gather in a ring around their owner, behind the people, so the tree stays readable.
landing.feature.private.title: Private by default
landing.feature.private.body: One owner, any number of editors and viewers. Invite by single-use link or email, and nothing is public.
landing.feature.generations.title: Generation-aware layouts
landing.feature.generations.body: Parents above children, partners on the same row, and a flip for oldest at top or bottom.
landing.feature.calendar.title: Birthdays and anniversaries
landing.feature.calendar.body: A calendar for every tree, with optional email reminders a week before, the day before, and the morning of.
landing.feature.presence.title: See who is looking
landing.feature.presence.body: Live presence shows who else has the tree open and which person or file they are viewing right now.
landing.feature.search.title: Find anyone fast
landing.feature.search.body: Search people and files, highlight their neighbours, then zoom straight to the branch you need.
landing.feature.mobile.title: Made for phones
landing.feature.mobile.body: A person sheet, touch gestures, and a search fallback that works when a whole tree will not fit.
landing.step.add.title: Add the people you remember
landing.step.add.body: Start with yourself, a parent, or the person whose stories you want to keep.
landing.step.connect.title: Connect the branches
landing.step.connect.body: Add parents, partners and children. Add a child and a second parent in one step.
landing.step.invite.title: Invite a relative
landing.step.invite.body: Send a link. Editors can add people and photos, viewers can read and explore.
landing.openSource.title: Free to use. Open to read.
landing.openSource.body: The whole app is MIT licensed. Run it on Railway, keep your data in your own Postgres, and change anything you like. No paywall, no locked features.
landing.cta.body: Add the people you remember, connect the branches, then invite a relative to help fill in the rest.
landing.cta.footnote: Free to use. No credit card needed.
landing.footer.disclaimer: Fictional demo data inspired by The Simpsons. Not affiliated with its rights holders. Portraits and photographs are original SVG approximations.

research.pedigree.note: Ahnentafel numbering: the subject is 1, each parent doubles the number, so slots 2 and 3 are the two parents and 4 to 7 are their parents. A known male parent is labelled father, a known female parent is labelled mother, and other or unknown sex reads as parent.

research.register.registerDescription: Register system: only the people whose line continues get a number. Children keep lowercase Roman labels in birth order.
research.register.ngsqDescription: NGSQ system: everyone gets a number in reading order, and a plus marks a line that continues.
